crossRefs.note: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

parallels.note: For the cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

translations.web: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.
translations.bsb: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its poles.
translations.kjv: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
translations.asv: For the cherubim spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
